profile_configuration: Initial unfused prototype, 500k source rows per case, two warmups/three pairs, software cpu-clock2ms, DWARF native stacks, threads and Java alloc1m. Both split and grouped-JSON cases completed with positive native-consumption checks. Profiled timings excluded from acceleration claims.
profile_findings: Redundant NativeCalc projection/JNI boundary and writes of discarded correlate columns are visible on producer stacks. Rust group update, JSON serialization, allocations/copies and state-output work appear on grouped native stacks. Inclusive frames overlap; native allocation calls do not provide allocation-byte totals. Raw Java allocation profiles do not measure Rust allocated bytes or peak heap.
decision: Fuse only pure column projection into the immediate table-function output writer. Retain Flink generated evaluation, LEFT padding, predicates, collector order and immediate copying of mutable output rows. Full function coverage/performance admission remains under validation.
limits: Stock medians drift between separate JVMs; do not attribute the entire unfused/pruned difference to one change.
The unfused control uses the same compiled producer with an identity projected view; it is a layout control, not the preceding released implementation.
The grouped win includes existing native JSON aggregation; standalone and grouped boundaries are reported separately.
Wider values, additional numeric shapes and other JVM function kinds are not established by this artifact.
